prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in key winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 4 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 5, and 8).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 5 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, 7, and 8).
choose_path layout changes (rounds 1, 5) and home notification changes (rounds 2, 6) consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each.
sign_in reorder changes proved harmful, leading to a guardrail rollback in round 3 and a negative result in round 9.
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, and all single-test kinds of change due to disagreeing outcomes or insufficient tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adopt Pet Studio Stage Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring live pet preview components to make picking a companion clearer. (why: Adoption stage has a significant conversion drop to 66.2% with a median time of 89s, indicating hesitation during pet selection.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Live Mascot Tips: Add an interactive tip carousel component during the desktop pet render waiting screen to keep users informed and engaged. (why: Home rendering step takes median 201s (mean 2336s). Lessons show wait_info improvements at home supported by 4 winning tests.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Interactive Sandbox Flow: Add a dedicated checklist screen after onboarding welcome teaching users how to hide, summon, and control their desktop pet. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries under [after_onboarding, confusion] about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Pet Account Auto-Save Persistence Notice: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining that authenticating preserves pet save state across application restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Pathway Orientation Screen: Insert an orientation screen before path choice that clearly explains the differences between quick adoption and custom creation. (why: Choose path has high mean duration (514s), showing users spend significant time deciding without clear context.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Tray Launch Guidance Sub-Flow: Add a final screen highlighting desktop tray placement and visibility toggle instructions. (why: Support received emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior and confusion around locating desktop controls after setup.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Rendering Audio Alert Toggle: Enable completion audio notification controls on the rendering screen to alert users when their pet is active on screen. (why: Mean wait time on home is 2336s, causing users to switch windows and miss when rendering completes.)
7: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Account Preservation Hint: Add a confirmation hint on the adoption certificate screen explicitly stating the pet is registered and backed up. (why: Support tickets show recurring anxiety around account data loss and pet resets after completing setup.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home Desktop Pet Commands Redesign: Redesign the home intro welcome screen into a checklist layout summarizing key pet interaction commands. (why: Finish step drop-off is 24.4% and users report post-onboarding confusion regarding pet interactions.)

scores.note: Adoption stage loses 33.8% of users, but redesigns consistently show negative performance (-2.1% historical average) and low confidence.
Home step has high conversion already (92.8%), but wait time is huge and wait_info is strongly backed by 4 winning tests (+1.8% avg).
Finish step drop is 24.4% with clear support mail evidence; finish new_flow has positive historical lift (+3.7%) though cost is high.
Sign-in drop is 19.9% backed by 8 support emails; hint changes are simple copy/config updates with proven positive lift (+1.5%).
Choose_path has high drop-off and duration, but adding new screens often adds friction and lacks historical support.
Addresses post-onboarding confusion backed by emails, but adding a new screen carries full release/code cost.
Home target step drop is low (7.2%); home notification changes consistently showed minimal clear effect (+0.6%).
Targets the biggest funnel bottleneck (adoption at 66.2%) backed by support ticket anxiety, cheap text hint to implement.
Finish step has 24.4% drop and support tickets exist, but layout redesigns historically tend to perform poorly.
